verses.1: And I will sit down and see all those works that are done under the sun. I will see the suffering and sorrow of those who do these works. They have no peace; they are constantly in pain, and there is no relief for them at all.
verses.2: And I will honor those who have died long since, among the living ones who still live today.
verses.3: And choose the better of them, those who did not see the evil deeds that were committed under the sunlight.
verses.4: And I saw all the efforts and all the hardships involved in doing this. It’s simply an act of jealousy on the part of one person towards his enemy. It’s still a form of evil and wickedness.
verses.5: The foolish person clenches his hands and eats his own flesh.
verses.6: Goodness is filled in the palm of one’s hand, from the filling of hard work and evil thoughts.
verses.7: And I sat down and saw the darkness under the sun.
verses.8: There is only one person, and there is no second one. There is no son or brother either. There’s no end to all his efforts. His eyes also won’t rest in peace. I work hard, but I’m still deprived of true happiness. It’s all just suffering and hardship.
verses.9: The two who are better than the one who has a good reward for their labor.
verses.10: For if one of them falls, he will build up his companion. And if the one who falls has no other to help him in building up.
verses.11: Even if two people lie down together, and it’s hot for them, how can one of them not feel hot?
verses.12: And if one of them attacks, the other two will stand against him. And the three-pronged spear won’t be used quickly enough to defeat him.
verses.13: A good child comes from a dangerous parent, and a wise person comes from an old and foolish king. But a fool is someone who doesn’t know how to be careful anymore.
verses.14: For from the house of the prisoners, a king was born. Also during his reign, a new ruler was born.
verses.15: I saw all the living creatures moving under the sun, along with the second child who stood beneath them.
verses.16: There is no hope for all people; even those who came before them did not rejoice over it. For it is still darkness and sorrow.
verses.17: Keep your feet steady as you go to the house of God. Do not listen to the foolish people who worship those who do not know how to do what is right.
